verses.gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਗਿਲਾਨਿ ਜਗਤ੍ਰਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਉਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bhiee gilaan jagatr vich chaar varan aasram upaae|

en.bdb: In view of the prevaling lassitude in the world, four varnas and four Ashrams were established.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀਆ ਜੋਗੀ ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥਿ ਚਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dhas naam sa(n)niaaseeaa jogee baareh pa(n)th chalaae|

en.bdb: Then ten orders of ascetics and twelve orders of yogis came into being.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਗਮ ਅਤੇ ਸਰੇਵੜੇ ਦਗੇ ਦਿਗੰਬਰਿ ਵਾਦਿ ਕਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: ja(n)gam ate sarevaRe dhage dhiga(n)bar vaadh karaae|

en.bdb: Further jangams, the wanderers, sramans and Digambrs, naked jain ascetics also started their disputations.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣਿ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣਿ ਲੜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: brahaman bahu parakaar kar saasatr vedh puraan laRaae|

en.bdb: Many Categories of brahmins came into being who propounded Shastras, Vedas and Purans contradicting one another.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਹੁ ਵੈਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਛਤੀਸਿ ਪਖੰਡ ਰਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: khaT dharasan bahu vair kar naal chhatees pakha(n)dd ralaae|

en.bdb: The mutual irreconcilability of the six Indian philosophies further added many hypocrisies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਰਾਸਾਇਣਾ ਕਰਾਮਾਤਿ ਕਾਲਖਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ
verses.translit_en: ta(n)t ma(n)t raasainaa karaamaat kaalakh lapaTaae

en.bdb: Alchemy, tantra,  mantra and miracles became everything for people.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸਿ ਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਕੁਰੂਪੀ ਘਣੇ ਦਿਖਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: eikas te bahu roop kar roop kuroopee ghane dhikhaae|

en.bdb: By getting divided into myriad sects (and castes) they produced a horrible look.
They all were deluded by kaliyug.
